exposure: Mode of delivery (Cesarean section vs. Vaginal delivery)
cohort: 300 women in Kashan, Iran, who had recently given birth
finding: There was no significant difference in the prevalence of PPD at 2 and 4 months postpartum between women who delivered via cesarean section and those who had a vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: While there was no significant difference in PPD prevalence between groups, women who had a vaginal delivery showed a greater decrease in EPDS score from 2 to 4 months postpartum.
